headline.en: Wet your lips and make a small, soft "oo" shape. Rest your tongue tip behind your bottom teeth, and blow slowly, as if cooling soup. Change the opening and your tongue a little at a time until a note comes.

title.en: A hiss with a faint note is the start

detail.en: For many people it takes a few days, not a minute
